title: Signature Cross-Shard Checksum Witnesses
description: A Signature original: shards witness each other's checksums in a ring, so a shard cannot hide its own corruption by lying about its hash. Witness disagreement triggers investigation. Signature-labeled; an original JAH design, not a public standard.

title: Signature Witness-Logged Quorum Repair
